description: Conversion funnel analyzer — Offline funnel analysis. Give stages= as Name:count pairs in order (comma-separated). Returns step and overall conversion, drop-offs, the biggest leak, and a what-if for improving that step (what_if_pct=, default 10% relative). Add compare= with the same stages for a second variant or period to get a two-proportion z-test per step (lift, p-value, winner) and overall lift. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: business_funnel
